messages:
alert-bot: Incident opened -> sudden spike in embedding and small-text generation 5xx/errors for hosted API in us-west-2. Detected 2512345678. Customers may see 503/timeout for short-lived requests. Runbook: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-9402 :rotating_light:

mona (oncall): seeing embed-store read latencies skyrocket and DB connection pool exhaustion logs on the embed-read tier. Error pattern: `too many connections` then `read timeout`. This aligns with a config push to the ingress batcher earlier.

raj: confirmed change: ingress-batcher config PR #5220 increased max-batch-window from 50ms -> 250ms for experimental throughput. It unintentionally batched many small requests into huge read sets, amplifying backend DB reads.

elaine: immediate mitigation options: (1) revert PR #5220 (fast), (2) apply ingress throttling to limit small-request fanout, (3) scale embed-read replicas. Doing revert + soft throttling now. ETA 12m.

support_mgr: drafting customer message: "We're investigating elevated errors for short generation and embedding requests in us-west-2. Engineers identified a batching configuration regression and are rolling mitigations. Status updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-9402."

mona (oncall): revert applied at 2512345800 -> ingress-batcher back to 50ms. Added short-term per-tenant soft-rate-limit for embedding calls at 2512345820.

alert-bot: Metrics update: embed read errors in us-west-2 dropped from 27% -> 4% within 6m of mitigation. Request latency median improved from 1.8s -> 650ms.

elaine: scaling note: spun up 6 additional embed-read replicas as buffer at 2512345865; autoscaler tuned to avoid overloading DB.

raj: hotfix checklist: revert PR #5220 (done), apply tenant soft-limits (done), scale read replicas (done), run sanity embed read test across tenants (queued).

support_mgr: initial customer note sent to impacted customers at 2512345905. We've offered to replay missed requests for enterprise customers where possible.

sre_lead: post-incident actions: (1) add canary check for ingress-batcher batch-window config and e2e embedding read amplification test, (2) add alert when embed-store read error rate >10% for >3m, (3) require perf QA signoff for batcher changes, (4) add per-tenant circuit-breaker to avoid blast radius. RCA owner: raj. Publish draft RCA to /docs/incidents/INC-9402 within 48h.

mona (oncall): monitoring for 30m. Two enterprise tenants reported transient gaps; solutions-eng engaged for follow-up.

alert-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (partial). Final update will be posted when RCA is published.
